artworks.title: Vue du Chateau de Versailles du Cote de l'Orangerie
artworks.description: The image shows the Château de Versailles from an elevated perspective, displaying the garden scene and architecture of the château. The top third of the image shows the horizon, lined with trees, with the château extending across it. The artwork is an intricate engraving with detailed line work capturing texture and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown for depth and contrast. People are depicted socializing and strolling in the foreground, while smaller figures are visible near the château in the background.

artworks.title: Vue de l'Orangerie de Versailles
artworks.description: The image depicts the Orangerie at Versailles. The scene includes a garden, terrace, and figures in period clothing. The sky has textured clouds. The garden has symmetrical trees, pathways, and a fountain leading to a large body of water. The etching uses precise linework and sepia tones to emphasize the garden's design.

artworks.title: Vue du Bassin de Latone Prise du Bord de la Terrasse du Chateau
artworks.description: The image is an engraving displaying a garden scene from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is lined with towering trees, and the engraving showcases detailed line work capturing textures of trees, water jets, and people in the garden. The color palette is sepia brown. In the distance is an ornate fountain surrounded by greenery, managed trees, statues, and urns.

artworks.title: Vue du Bassin de Neptune dans le Jardin de Versailles
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed view of the Bassin de Neptune in the Gardens of Versailles. The horizon is filled with trees surrounding the scene, and the sky has scattered clouds in a grayscale palette. Trees and water jets create depth in the image. People in period clothing are seen walking, talking, or observing. A horse-drawn carriage is prominent. A large fountain with water jets is a striking feature on the water's surface. The color palette is sepia, emphasizing the detailed etching. The artist's brushstrokes are precise, creating a detailed scene of the gardens and fountain.

artworks.title: Vue de Trianon dans le Parc de Versailles du Cote de l'Avenue
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural scene with a view of the Trianon within the Versailles park. The horizon line is low, defined by the building with columns and sculptures. The engraving shows detailed textures in the trees and clouds. The color palette is sepia. People are engaged in activities, and horses and carriages are present. The building's architecture is elegant and symmetric, framed by trees. The sky is partly cloudy.

artworks.title: Vue du Chateau de Trianon du Cote du Parterre
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a view of the Château de Trianon from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is at the top with tall trees marking the garden's boundary. The engraving has intricate line work, and a grayscale color palette. Figures in period clothing are shown in the scene engaging in various activities. A fountain is the central focus, surrounded by gardens. The Château's grand facade is on the left, framing the composition.

artworks.title: Vue du Paysage de la Maison Royalle de Saint Cir
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with an elevated perspective. The horizon is near the top, featuring a grand building with a spire, surrounded by smaller structures and trees. The detailed etching style uses intricate linework for textures and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in tones of brown and beige. People and animals are engaging in activities on a rugged landscape in the foreground, with trees on both sides. The scene transitions to a pastoral landscape leading to architectural features in the background.

artworks.title: La Salle du Bal
artworks.description: The image shows a garden scene, featuring a gathering space within the gardens of Versailles. The view is slightly elevated, offering a wide perspective. Tall trees surround the scene, creating an enclosed atmosphere. The etching style is detailed, providing texture to the foliage and figures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown, resembling a sepia-tone print. Elegantly dressed figures in baroque attire are seen engaging in social activities. In the background, there are terraced levels with steps, a grand waterfall, statues, and urns. Lush trees provide a natural backdrop to the structured garden setting.

artworks.title: La Colonade
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed architectural scene with a circular colonnade. Large classical columns frame a series of elegant arcades forming a circle. In the background, a statue is surrounded by water fountains. The horizon is low, above the arcades, and lush trees populate the backdrop. The composition features intricate lines with a monochromatic sepia color palette. Elegantly dressed figures are in the foreground, while detailed trees and sky complete the scene.

artworks.title: L'Isle Royalle
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with a central pond surrounded by a colonnade. Fountains spray water at intervals in the pond. Figures in detailed attire are walking and conversing in the garden. The scene is depicted with a cross-hatching technique, creating a textured look. The color scheme is primarily sepia, giving an antique feel to the image.

artworks.title: La Salle aux Marronniers
artworks.description: The image displays a garden scene with a spacious outdoor corridor bordered by tall trees and hedges. The horizon is high in the composition, partially hidden by the trees. A small statue or structure is visible on the horizon. The engraving features detailed lines rendering the foliage, clothing, and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic, using varying browns and sepia tones. Finely dressed individuals are engaged in leisure activities, with smaller figures dispersed along the path. The path extends towards a structure in the distance framed by trees.

artworks.title: Le Bassin d'Apollon
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated perspective of a grand open area with an ornate fountain at the center. A dense wooded area marks the low horizon, with billowing clouds in the sky above. The intricate etching style captures fine details of natural elements and structured garden design. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and beige. People dressed in period clothing are depicted walking and socializing, with a prominent fountain featuring classical statues and water streams centrally located. The scene conveys a sense of structured elegance, typical of formal gardens and promenades.

artworks.title: Le Bassin d'Encelade
artworks.description: The image features a circular fountain named "Le Bassin d'Encelade," with a central jet of water shooting upwards. Surrounding the fountain are dense trees, creating a formal garden or park setting. The artwork appears to be an etching or engraving with detailed lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, showcasing a monochromatic palette. Figures in elegant attire are present around the fountain, some with wheeled chairs or carriages. The scene includes bustling paths with people interacting, along with individuals strolling in the distance, depicting human activity in a structured natural environment.

artworks.title: L'Obelisque
artworks.description: The image shows a park scene from an elevated point of view. Large trees surround the area, obscuring the horizon. In the center, there is an obelisk-shaped fountain. The trees are drawn with detailed pencil-like strokes. Figures in period clothing are present near the fountain. The style includes intricate line work emphasizing textures in the trees and water ripples. The color palette is mostly gray, creating contrast and depth. The perspective adds to the sense of grandeur and scale, with pathways guiding viewers through the scene.

artworks.title: Le Théâtre d'Eau
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a water feature in the center. The view is from above, showing a busy amphitheater-like setting surrounded by tall trees. Fountains stand out in the scene creating a display against the backdrop of trees. The illustration is detailed, with attention to foliage and water movement. The color scheme is limited to sepia and gray tones. Figures in historical attire are engaged in social activities, with carriages and garden furniture adding to the setting.

artworks.title: Les Domes
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a garden with a fountain complex. The view is slightly elevated, showing the fountain at the center. Flanking the fountain are two pavilions with statues, surrounded by trees. The artist used detailed lines and shading to create a monochromatic scene. Figures in 18th-century clothing gather around the fountain.

artworks.title: Les Bains d'Apollon
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is not explicitly defined, with dense foliage and pavilion structures filling the upper portion of the composition. In the center and extending into the background are three ornate pavilions, with the largest in the middle, flanked by smaller ones on either side. The scene is composed with detailed brushwork that captures intricate textures of both the architectural elements and natural surroundings. The color palette is monochromatic, with muted sepia tones and soft contrasts between light and shadow. Elegantly dressed figures are gathered around a circular water feature, with more figures walking along pathways bordered by trees.

artworks.title: Les Trois Fontaines
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a fountain display at the center, viewed from slightly above ground level. In the background, there is a line of trees with the sky peeking through. The fountain has intricate details with water jets creating parabolic arcs. People in period attire are around the fountain, engaged in various activities. The image is created with precise lines and shading in a monochromatic color palette of brown and sepia tones.

artworks.title: L'Arc de Triomphe
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden scene depicted in a monochrome etching style. The view is symmetrical, showing a pathway with fountains leading to a temple-like structure in the distance. Lush trees frame the scene. The details are finely textured, and figures are precisely rendered in period attire. The color palette is limited to shades of black, white, and gray, accentuating the detailed line work. People in period attire are seen strolling and conversing in the garden, with water features and stone carvings adding decoration.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: The Dregs of Society (Las bas-fonds de la societe)
artworks.description: This image features a central figure surrounded by various smaller scenes. The central image is of a large book or banner with the text "Bas-Fonds de la Société par Joseph Prud'homme Photographe à Paris," adorned with a jester or symbolic figure. Around this centerpiece, there are several smaller vignettes depicting a variety of scenes, including interactions among people. At the top, rays of light extend from a set of hands holding a glowing orb. The bottom center features a depiction of a seated figure with the word "Vérité" inscribed on a block beneath it. Each vignette varies in content, showing pairs of individuals engaged in conversation, intimate settings, or comical or allegorical scenes.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: The Waifs (Les Epaves)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central skeleton with branching antlers, surrounded by floating mythical creatures, plant-like elements, and various symbols. Floating figures and cherubs are depicted at the top, with the text "Les Épaves de Charles Baudelaire" above. Below, skeletal remains intertwine with vegetation, labeled with words like "superbia," "libido," and "ira." In the center, a circular emblem with a bird symbol is featured. The scene is detailed and full of allegorical content related to themes like decay, life and death, and potentially moral or philosophical concepts.

artworks.title: The Red Iron (Le Fer Rouge)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a central pole with a signpost labeled "SEDAN METZ" and a rooster on top. Two figures in period attire are holding banners and blowing trumpets while seated back-to-back. Below them is a caged bird among skulls. In the background, there are ornate lines of text.

artworks.title: Belgian Border, Bill of Disorder (Frontiere de Belgique. Billet a Desordre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a border crossing scene with a man being pushed out of a crescent moon sculpture labeled "FRONTIÈRE." Nearby, a stone pedestal with a lion labeled "BELGICUS LEO" can be seen. Various items are flying around the man, and there are scattered books or documents on the ground, one labeled "EUROPA." The top of the canvas is filled with abstract, cloud-like smudges, adding to the chaotic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Gaspard de la Nuit
artworks.description: This is an illustration depicting a mysterious and eerie scene. The image includes a cluttered table with various objects, a piece of paper titled "Fantaisies A La Maniere De Rembrandt et De Callot," and a surreal fog or smoke. Various fantastical creatures such as demons and skeletons are floating around the scene. In the background, a moon shines through a gothic window archway. The drawing conveys a sense of mystical disturbance and otherworldly elements.
